categories.name: build
categories.evidence: Matches 'Build system' label and directly modifies CMake build scripts (CMakeLists.txt and cmake/module/InstallBinaryComponent.cmake) to add install targets.
categories.rationale: Adds CMake installation rules for shell completions so packagers and users do not need to manually copy scripts from contrib/completions/. This provides clear convenience for packaging workflows without impacting core release integrity or platform build support.
